description:
NEW FILE: apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/extension/macro.ex (or inline into behaviour.ex)

Implement the 'use OctoPi.Coder.Extension' macro.

WHAT THE MACRO DOES:
1. Injects '@behaviour OctoPi.Coder.Extension.Behaviour' into the using module.
2. Registers a '__before_compile__' hook.
3. In __before_compile__/1: scan the module for exported handle_* functions using Module.definitions_in(env.module, :def). For each matching name + arity, record it.
4. Generate a def init(api) function body that:
   a. If mount/0 is exported: call __MODULE__.mount(), pattern-match {:ok, initial_state}, then start the Agent:
      - If api.agent_supervisor is set (production path via Extension.Manager): call DynamicSupervisor.start_child(api.agent_supervisor, {Agent, fn -> initial_state end}) to get state_agent pid. The Agent is owned by the DynamicSupervisor, not linked to the calling process.
      - If api.agent_supervisor is nil (test path via load_from_factory): fall back to Agent.start_link(fn -> initial_state end). The Agent is linked to the test process and cleaned up when the test ends.
   b. For each 2-arity handle_<event_type>/2 found: emit API.on(api, :<event_type>, fn event, ctx -> __MODULE__.handle_<event_type>(event, ctx) end).
   c. For each 3-arity handle_<event_type>/3 found: emit API.on(api, :<event_type>, fn event, ctx -> state = Agent.get(state_agent, & &1); {result, new_state} = __MODULE__.handle_<event_type>(event, ctx, state); Agent.update(state_agent, fn _ -> new_state end); result end). This closure closes over state_agent pid.
   d. Return {:ok, api}.
5. If mount/0 is exported: also generate 'def __state_agent__, do: state_agent_pid' for test introspection. Not part of the public extension API.

AGENT LIFECYCLE:
In production (Extension.Manager path): the DynamicSupervisor owns the Agent. Extension.Manager dies -> DynamicSupervisor dies -> Agent dies. No manual cleanup. Agent crash is absorbed by the DynamicSupervisor and does not affect Extension.Manager or the coding agent.
In tests (load_from_factory path): Agent is linked to the test process and exits when the test ends. No manual cleanup needed.

API.t() CHANGES:
- Add agent_supervisor: pid() | nil field (default nil).
- Add state_agent: pid() | nil field (set during init/1 if mount/0 is present, stored so Extension.Manager can record it for introspection).
- Extension.t() gains state_agent: pid() | nil field; set in API.build_extension/2.

BACKWARDS COMPATIBILITY: Extensions NOT using 'use OctoPi.Coder.Extension' continue to work identically. The macro is purely additive.

Requires: opi-fin.2.1 (Extension.Behaviour) merged first.
Coordinating change: opi-fin.3.1 (Extension.Manager) sets api.agent_supervisor before calling Module.init/1. These two tickets must be developed together or opi-fin.3.1 must follow opi-fin.2.2.

TEST: macro_test.exs
1. Stateless extension using macro auto-registers its handle_* fn.
2. Stateful extension using mount/0 gets state threaded correctly across two handler calls.
3. __state_agent__/0 returns a pid.
4. State updates from one handler are visible to the next handler call.
5. With agent_supervisor set: Agent is a child of the DynamicSupervisor, not linked to caller.
6. With agent_supervisor nil: Agent is linked to caller (test process).
title: Implement use OctoPi.Coder.Extension macro
